required.plannedAt: ISO-8601 timestamp aligned to one minute
required.entryZone: { from: finite positive number, to: finite positive number }
required.candles: confirmed 1m OHLC array covering the required replay interval

optional.strategyVersion: saved strategy identifier when explicitly available; null when archive did not persist one

inputSchema.candle: { timestamp: epoch milliseconds, open, high, low, close: finite positive numbers, confirmed: true }
